item.title: Windows Secure Kernel (VTL1/VSM) Memory Corruption PoC (CVE-2026-26179 / ZDI-26-276)
item.description: High severity — binary · CVE-2026-26179 / ZDI-26-276. Status: PoC. Affects: Windows Secure Kernel / Virtual Secure Mode (VSM), Virtual Trust Level 1 (VTL1) transfer functions (nt!VslpLockPagesForTransfer, VslpEnterIumSecureMode, nt!VslpUnlockPagesForTransfer). Tags: secure-kernel, vsm, vtl1, windows-kernel, hyper-v, mdl, memory-corruption, driver.
